documented_probe: C-4f563c9d (fetch both model weights and tokenizer artifacts so offline loading succeeds; min difficulty medium): the task requires persisting every artifact the offline loader inspects (config, weights shard, vocab, merges, tokenizer_config, special_tokens_map) into one servable mirror, verified by an actual network-free load that returns working objects, plus the complete-mirror property (deleting any artifact must break the load) and hidden upstream trees (fresh, corrupted digest, missing source).
notes: Two-stage: write a generalized manifest-driven mirror builder, then run it to bake the visible mirror and prove the offline load. Medium floor from the complete-mirror discipline (atomic failure semantics, distractor files, digest verification) and hidden-case generalization over fresh/corrupt/missing upstream trees. No tool breadth, no environment pressure.
